Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer pivoted to retrieving YouTube transcripts via a Python script to find the on-screen phrase. Transcripts capture spoken audio, not visual title cards, so this approach was misaligned with the goal. It also led to an infeasible tool path (installing pytube) in the given environment, causing loops and preventing progress toward identifying and counting the letter “E” in the on-screen phrase.
